sentence_stem: Never before had the city seen such a storm,
correct_completion: nor had its people ever faced such fear.
full_sentence: Never before had the city seen such a storm, nor had its people ever faced such fear.
acceptable_variants: nor had they ever felt such fear.
nor had anyone ever faced such fear there.

options.text: nor had its people ever faced such fear.
and its people faced such fear.
options.why_wrong: A normal word order cannot follow a fronted negative, so the auxiliary must come before the subject.

options.text: nor its people had faced such fear.
options.why_wrong: After 'nor', the auxiliary must invert with the subject, so this order is incorrect.

options.text: its people faced such fear either.
options.why_wrong: 'Either' does not complete a negative inversion; the structure requires 'nor' and inverted auxiliary.

grammar_focus: Inversion after negative 'nor' for rhetorical emphasis
explanation: When a negative clause is followed by 'nor', the auxiliary is inverted with the subject, which adds emphasis to the parallel negative statement.
translation: ከተማዋ ከዚህ በፊት እንዲህ ያለ ማዕበል አይታ አታውቅም፤ ሕዝቧም እንዲህ ያለ ፍርሃት ገጥሟቸው አያውቅም።
